IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_BuildDescript: Gradually restores directly stored perishable food while powered and enabled. Sandbox capacity: 50–1000, default 200. Restoration is credited only during continuously observed, loaded and powered intervals; no unloaded/offline catch-up.
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_Hours: Game hours to restore one full fresh-life interval: %1
IGUI_SuQingFreshnessFridge_ObservedOnly: Directly stored food only. No credit for unloaded, offline or unverified-power intervals.
